in_marathi.name: Gitansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे One who chants the sacred hymns
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gitansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gitansh is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘git’ meaning hymns or sacred verses, and ‘ansh’ meaning one who chants or recites. This name represents a person who is deeply rooted in spirituality and is devoted to the study and recitation of sacred texts.
